name: Crisis Service Ribbon (full-size medal body)
size_basis: Raster proportion: the ribbon in images/mini_medals/mcchord/m_crisis.webp is 1.375 in wide (ribbon measured 50 px in the source raster) (full size 1 3/8 in; coordination chat citing DoDM 1348.33; CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions); the medal body is measured at 50 x 53 source px = 1.375 x 1.458 in at that scale. Width kept from the previous asset; the product photo shows the medal disc and suspension ring, height now 1.6778 in (was 1.4575).

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: https://vanguardmil.com/products/copy-of-civil-air-patrol-miniature-medal-life-saving; vendor product photograph (Vanguard Military Products), used only as a measurement reference; licence not stated by the vendor

fit.metric: silhouette IoU vs photo foreground mask at working resolution
fit.note: Posterised to 5 flat sampled tones (smoothed, Chaikin + RDP, specks dropped); 4 nested tone layers over the traced silhouette.
